qa_pair.question: Using only read-only Starshipit WMS tools, look up the warehouse product whose SKU is the first SKU returned on page 1 of a product search that matches a single exact catalogue item you have already confirmed exists. What is that product's WMS record id (not the SKU)?
Find the product you looked up by SKU, then open its inventory detail. How many distinct location rows are attached to that product in the detailed inventory response?
List inventory in location view, searching for a pick-face location name that exists in the account. What is that location's WMS location id?
List WMS jobs with status READY and type PICK, page 1, limit 25, paginated. How many jobs are in this first page?
From the READY pick jobs list, take the first job. Open the standard job record (not the details view). What is that job's priority integer?
List purchase orders with status receivable. How many purchase orders are returned in that unpaginated list (or the limit you used if you had to cap it)?
List suppliers, then open the first supplier that has a non-empty name. What is that supplier's WMS id?
List locations with includeOccupancy true and a page size of 25. How many locations on page 1 have a type of PICK_FACE?
List stock movements for a date window that is fully in the past and already closed in this warehouse (use startDate and endDate). How many movement rows are on page 1 with limit 50?

Call whoami, then list products with page 1 and limit 1. What is the catalogue total_count (or equivalent total) reported for products or inventory, using the same source you can reproduce on a second read-only call?
